delta: Remove the reinstall page and every chained previous-uninstaller path; accept only in-place supported NSIS predecessors and protected fresh destinations.
Hold the installation gate from onInit through terminal callbacks and maintenance; bound host/process checks and remove stock process-kill calls.
Run fixed install/uninstall maintenance, propagate failure with a machine-readable result, and release the transaction before relaunch.
qualification: Static/generated-script checks do not prove native mutex lifetime or installation behavior; isolated Windows qualification is pending.
